script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Drama
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

Title: Unseen Horizon

INT. JAMES' APARTMENT - DAY

JAMES, a driven yet anxious thirtysomething, sits at his cluttered kitchen table, staring at a large world map spread before him. He clutches a cup of lukewarm coffee, the steam fogging up his glasses as he ponders his next move.

JAMES
(whispering to himself)
There has to be a way. I can't keep living like this.

INT. JAMES' APARTMENT - LIVING ROOM - CONTINUOUS

James' friend OLIVER enters, wearing a broad smile. He sets a bag of groceries down on the coffee table.

OLIVER
Hey, buddy! I brought you some supplies for dinner.

JAMES
(sighing)
Thanks, Oliver. I appreciate it.

OLIVER
(noticing the map)
What's that? A new hobby?

JAMES
(hesitating)
No, just... dreams.

OLIVER
(supportively)
Everyone has dreams, James.

JAMES
(frustrated)
I know, but mine seem so out of reach. I want to travel the world, explore new places, meet new people. But I'm stuck here, living paycheck to paycheck.

OLIVER
(leaning against the kitchen counter)
Have you thought about starting a business? Something that can generate income while you're on the road?

JAMES
(surprised)
Really? That's an idea.

OLIVER
Yeah, you've got a unique perspective on things. Why not use that to your advantage?

INT. JAMES' APARTMENT - NIGHT

James types away at his laptop, researching potential business ideas. Oliver sits across from him, offering suggestions and encouragement.

JAMES
(excitedly)
I've got it! A travel blog! I can document my journeys and share them with the world.

OLIVER
(smiling)
Perfect! Now all you need is a plan and some start-up capital.

INT. JAMES' APARTMENT - WEEKS LATER

James sits at his kitchen table, surrounded by packing boxes. He looks at Oliver, who stands in the doorway, wearing a proud grin.

JAMES
(emotionally)
I can't believe it. I'm really doing this.

OLIVER
(tearing up)
You've got this, man. The world is yours for the taking.

INT. AIRPORT - DAY

James, now dressed in travel clothes, hugs Oliver goodbye before entering the airport. The camera pans out as he disappears into the crowd, the title "Unseen Horizon" appearing on the screen.

FADE OUT.

INT. A PUBLIC LIBRARY - DAY

JAMES, looking older and more world-weary, sits at a table, surrounded by stacks of books. He's typing away at his laptop, a determined look on his face. A young woman, EMMA, approaches him.

EMMA
(curiously)
Hey, I've seen you here before. Are you a writer?

JAMES
(smiling)
Not exactly. I'm a travel blogger.

EMMA
(excitedly)
Wow! I've always loved to travel. Can I read some of your work?

JAMES
(happily)
Of course! Here, take a look at this.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - NIGHT

James and Emma sit at a table, sharing stories and laughter. They've become close friends over the years, their bond strengthened by their mutual love of adventure.

EMMA
(serious)
James, you've changed my life. Your blog has inspired me to travel and explore the world.

JAMES
(gratefully)
That means the world to me, Emma. I'm just glad I could help.

INT. JAMES' APARTMENT - YEARS LATER

James, now an older man, sits in his cozy apartment, surrounded by memories of his travels. He receives a knock on the door. It's Oliver, who looks proud and content.

OLIVER
(excitedly)
James, I've got some amazing news! You've been nominated for a prestigious travel writing award.

JAMES
(shocked)
Really? That's incredible!

OLIVER
(grinning)
Absolutely! And I'm not the only one who thinks so. You've touched the lives of so many people, and now it's time for you to be recognized for your accomplishments.

JAMES
(teary-eyed)
Oliver, this means the world to me. Thank you for believing in me all those years ago.

FADE OUT.

THE END
